$schema_comment: Max sizes for packed npm artifacts (attacker-visible / release RE gates). Adjust deliberately when intentional growth lands.

clawql-mcp.comment: 80 MiB — root pack includes providers/ OpenAPI corpus + dist

clawql-*.comment: 15 MiB default for workspace clawql-* and mcp-* packs

sourceMaps.comment: Most clawql-* packs still emit tsup/esbuild .map under dist/. Set true (or CLAWQL_FORBID_SOURCE_MAPS=1) once packages exclude maps from the files field — maps expose internal paths to attackers.
